mandatory_sdk_gaps.binding: MANDATORY_OPEN_LANGUAGE_OR_PACKAGE_VARIANT; no normative catalog mutation or closed acceptance
mandatory_sdk_gaps.detail: High-level Python sync/async signatures, context lifecycle, turn handles, login handles, ExternalMessage, retries and errors need language-specific future variants; TS34 is insufficient.

mandatory_sdk_gaps.binding: MANDATORY_OPEN_LANGUAGE_OR_PACKAGE_VARIANT; no normative catalog mutation or closed acceptance
mandatory_sdk_gaps.detail: Direct and transitive RPC bindings are source partial; generic method names, approvals, goals, subscription races/cancellation, overload and transport failures need concrete oracles.

mandatory_sdk_gaps.binding: MANDATORY_OPEN_LANGUAGE_OR_PACKAGE_VARIANT; no normative catalog mutation or closed acceptance
mandatory_sdk_gaps.detail: All generated classes/fields/aliases/default expressions inventoried; Pydantic runtime behavior/inherited methods, generator normalization and schema equivalence unverified.

mandatory_sdk_gaps.binding: MANDATORY_OPEN_LANGUAGE_OR_PACKAGE_VARIANT; no normative catalog mutation or closed acceptance
mandatory_sdk_gaps.detail: SDK 0.0.0-dev / dependency runtime 0.153.4 / minimum 0.151.0 / Git source pin are different identities; no binary/wheel inspected, downloaded or executed. No manifest-only provenance authentication.

mandatory_sdk_gaps.binding: MANDATORY_OPEN_LANGUAGE_OR_PACKAGE_VARIANT; no normative catalog mutation or closed acceptance
mandatory_sdk_gaps.detail: Original 34 AST export records preserved and source-bound; regex binding is not TypeScript typechecking or runtime qualification. Abort/JSONL/exec cleanup variants remain mandatory.

mandatory_sdk_gaps.binding: MANDATORY_OPEN_LANGUAGE_OR_PACKAGE_VARIANT; no normative catalog mutation or closed acceptance
mandatory_sdk_gaps.detail: OS/arch/wheel/package manager/vendor fallback/install/authenticated artifacts and proxy wrapper behavior need functional qualification; developer helpers do not count as product APIs.

mandatory_external_runtime_limits.detail: No audit of serde/serde_core/derive, indexmap, zmij, IDNA, encoding, RNG or any downstream dependency closure.
Declarations and conditional/default/optional feature edges only; no Cargo resolution, selected target, build invocation, cfg evaluation or activated-feature receipt.
URL parsing/IDNA, file-path conversions, platform helpers, native byte handling and OS behavior have no runtime qualification.
Authenticated source binds branches; numeric/UUID/URL/string grammar, serde format behavior, recursion/budget, duplicate handling and resource behavior have no executable target oracle.
No G01 closure, functional receipt, CVG grant, production/release approval or full third-party security audit.

mandatory_next_gates: G04 concrete SPEC and applicable review before BUILD
limits: Lexical name/arm/view linkage and source module routes are candidates, not causal delivery or compiled reachability.
Effect requirement links supplement UI entry obligations; domain ownership stays in the normative catalog. Event effect owner remains OPEN.
Static grammar, dynamic model tiers, macros, cfg, platform/terminal behavior, providers and all functional results remain OPEN/NOT_RUN.
No target execution, runtime implementation, functional receipt, full G01 closure, native parity, CVG bypass or release is granted.
